Reporting_Req: Purpose: Bidders to produce the reports required in the documentation given to ensure the system has the capabilities to provide transparency to MABKargo for its machine availability and performance.

The system must provide comprehensive reporting capabilities that enable operational transparency, support proactive maintenance planning, optimize resource utilization, and facilitate management decision-making through reliable and exportable reports.

The bidder shall demonstrate the system's capability to generate, configure, filter, schedule and export the following reports:
1. System Performance Report
2. Machine Availability Report
3. Machine Fault Analysis Report
4. Machine Health Report
5. Inventory Report
6. System and Machine Utilization Report
7. Optimization Report
Report parameter selection, filtering by date/equipment/location, drill-down capability, dashboard visualization (if available), scheduled report generation, and export to common formats (PDF/Excel/CSV) should be demonstrated.

1. Reports are generated accurately using historical data if available, or using data the captures the operational efficiency of Cargo Terminal Operators. 
2. Users are allowed to schedule or automate recurring reports generation for MABKargo's utilization.

Bidders to demonstrate the capability of sytem to produce the reports as per below: 
1. System Performance Report
2. Machine Availability Report
3. Machine Fault Analysis Report
4. Machine Health Report
5. Inventory Report
6. System and Machine Utilization Report
7. Optimization Report
Maint_Req: Purpose: Bidders to provide the system that related on maintenance which include the graphical user on the maintenance strategy, planning and decision as well.

The system must be able to provide the maintenance strategy and planning. The strategy include to optimize the resources and make sure the availability of the machine is sustain to avoid jeopardize to the operations.

The bidder shall demonstrate the system's capability to plan and strategize the maintenance to optimize the resources align with the machine availability. It is include the following capability:
1. Strategy on Maintenance Optimization
2. Maintenance Planning Upon Breakdown
3. Equipment Availability Calculation on Service Level Availability

1. System able to planning the maintenance accordingly without jeopardize the operations
2. The system interface have a friendly graphical

1. System propose by Bidders to be user friendly and interactive graphical user interface for warehouse operation's utilization. 
2. Solution must be designed with sufficient flexibility to remain adaptable for the next 10 years. 
3. Solution must be future proof min next 10 years
4. Solution to have Induction of advanced automation & robotics technology where applicable to improve cargo handling process with higher efficiency, cycle time and productivity

Bidders to demonstrate a maintenance system that is capable for: 
• Equipment performance checks and inspections
• Condition monitoring and trend analysis
• Adjustments, lubrication, and cleaning
• Routine replacement of wear‑and‑tear components

• Predictive maintenance techniques
• Maintenance of technical documentation and library
• Supply of consumables (lubricants, cleaning materials, etc.)

Bidders to demonstrate on how the system availability to be calculated through the formula, the monitoring tools used, the measurement period, and how downtime is recorded and reported. Targeted output for System Avaialbiltiy for Cargo Application must be at 98% during demonstration.

IT&Project_DLV: Purpose: Bidders to present the system integration planning to ensure that seamless integration is proposed for enhanced operational efficiency  within MABKargo's warehouse.

The system must have the capabilities to process the commands directed from the Logistics Management System (LMS) to ensure that the cargo handling processes are per the functional requirement. The system must also be able to integrate with current LMS and act as an executor for the commands and record the movements of the cargo vice versa.

Key capabiltiies include: 
1. Full integration with Logistics Management System (LMS). 
2. System must be able to integrate with the MH Internal Systems Scope.
3. Integration planning proposed must be viable for operations on day to day basis.
1. A fully integrated system with current Logistics Management System (LMS)  acting as the interface and the Warehouse Management System (WMS) acting as the executor.
Bidder to present project implementation plan and approach, timeline and etc
Bidder to present proposed integration approach
Bidder to present platform integration capabilities, available APIs
Bidder to present proposed scope for integration with MH internal systems
